name: Kneeler Bracket (Atwood-Hamlin)
description: The steel side brackets that attach the kneeler to the pew and carry the pivot stud and rubber-stop stud. Sold in pairs (left + right mirror). Atwood-Hamlin's Arm 4 pivots 3½" off the floor; Arm 5 pivots 2" off the floor — Arms 4 and 5 are the most common types. Supplied by Atwood-Hamlin Mfg. Co, Inc. (800-545-8964 · sales@atwood-hamlin.com). The STLs below are reference geometry only; order the steel originals from Atwood-Hamlin.
assemblyGuide: Identify your bracket number (4 or 5) by measuring the pivot height from the floor — 3½" is Arm 4, 2" is Arm 5.
Remove the old bracket by unscrewing the two mounting screws from the kneeler frame.
Align the new bracket and drive the mounting screws supplied with it.
Reinstall the kneeler bushing, spacer, pivot bolt, and bumper before re-hanging the kneeler.
Contact Atwood-Hamlin directly if unsure which bracket number you need: 800-545-8964 or sales@atwood-hamlin.com
